# FM door: identity-coherence rollout over the two new surfaces

## Context
Sub of epic #15519 (graduated D#15498; Ada's surface-coherence precedent). Every outward surface inherits the `#12225` / `neo-identity-update` obligations; this epic adds exactly two.

## The Work
Run the `neo-identity-update` rollout over the storefront repo (metadata, README facts) and the site: FACTS derive from one source, FRAMING segments by audience (the poly-harness addressee here; the depth story stays the engine repo's), CTAs governed (one canonical launch URL). Register both as standing governed consumers so future identity updates sweep them automatically.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Both surfaces pass the coherence protocol's checks; registered in the rollout's consumer list.
- [ ] No fact appears on the new surfaces that does not derive from the governed source.
